node.label: Lizabeth Cohen
node.date_label: Making a New Deal (1990) · A Consumers’ Republic (2003) · Saving America’s Cities (2019)
node.description: American social historian whose studies connect workers, consumers, public power and the built environment. Cohen’s interview on Saving America’s Cities explains her shift from ordinary groups to Ed Logue’s public career, retaining attention to social identities and unequal resources. She interprets urban renewal through changing relations between planning experts and community participation, with costs as well as achievements.
